title: Recovering Withheld Depreciation under the RentGuard Renters Policy
content:
When a RentGuard Renters Policy contents payment on a replacement-cost tier is made at actual cash value with the depreciation withheld, the withheld amount (the holdback) can be recovered once replacement is documented. This note sets out the rule in questions answered.

**When is the holdback released?**
Only when proof of replacement is received no later than the depreciation recovery period that starts on the date of the initial actual-cash-value payment. The period is counted in calendar days from the date that payment was issued, using the tier's depreciation recovery period, and proof received on the last day is on time.

**How much is released?**
The smaller of the remaining holdback and the documented replacement cost — capped at the replacement-cost value — less the actual cash value, and never below 0.00. The actual cash value is the replacement-cost value less the depreciation.

**Can a holdback be released in parts?**
Yes. Partial releases are allowed, each against the holdback that remains.

**What happens to a holdback not released in time?**
Any holdback left when the recovery period ends is forfeited in one entry.

**What about a claim payment that was voided?**
A payment that has already been voided is never voided again, and a voided payment is reissued as a new payment of the same amount.

## Worked release (hypothetical)

Replacement-cost value 3000.00, depreciation 900.00, so actual cash value 2100.00 and a holdback of 900.00.

| Documented replacement cost | Capped at replacement-cost value | Less actual cash value | Release (the smaller of that and the holdback, not below 0.00) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2600.00 | 2600.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 |
| 3400.00 | 3000.00 | 900.00 | 900.00 |
| 1900.00 | 1900.00 | below 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Timing boundary

Proof received on the last day of the recovery period is on time and may release depreciation; proof received the day after the period ends is late, and the holdback still remaining at the end of the period is forfeited.
